title: Glo Class Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Down Dog sessions (`downdog:session`), Peloton yoga classes (`peloton:yoga`), Glo classes (`glo:class`), Pilates sessions (`pilates:session`), and mat usage logs (`mat:usage`).
app: Down Dog session logs, Peloton yoga classes, Glo streaming sessions, Pilates reformer notes, and home mat usage counters sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glo:class
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by style
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>72
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when Glo class data has stopped arriving for a given style.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per style and alert when the feed is older than 72 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors when one part of your Glo class feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
